composites.name: readdy-demo
composites.description: Tiny ReaDDy reaction-diffusion demo: a few species-A particles diffusing in a small periodic box with first-order decay. Emits total_particles, energy, and time each step.

interval.description: Process interval in simulator time units. ReaDDy advances n_steps = round(interval/timestep).

decay_rate.description: First-order decay rate for species A (rate of `A -> nothing`).

initial_count.description: Number of A particles to create at the origin region at t=0.

composites.name: readdy-demo-with-viz
composites.description: ReaDDy reaction-diffusion demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar trajectories (total_particles, energy), written to the 'viz_html' store.

interval.description: Process interval in simulator time units.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

decay_rate.description: First-order decay rate for species A.
